## Dondena AI and Society Initiative (DAISI)

I direct [DAISI](https://dondena.unibocconi.eu/research-areas/welfare-state-and-taxation-unit/dondena-ai-and-society-initiative-daisi),
launched in 2024 within the Dondena Centre for Research on Social Dynamics and
Public Policy. The initiative studies how artificial intelligence is changing
work, politics, and social life — and how public policy should respond.
